set.body:
User review actual 8/mockup evidence cards. Move drawn anchor and its origin/mass into a distinct card; label zero-mass fill drawn (not in posterior). Reuse existing complete timed-anchor alternatives, ranks, exact text and within-group spans. Rank real posterior candidates 1..n including a positive-mass drawn target at its proper place, with a declared deterministic tie rule. Label top alternative clearly; give within-group strip explicit clock bounds and support-grain explanation. Current compiler emits every candidate for timed anchored units: do not invent an existing top-k loss. If a shortened list/bar is introduced, retain exact full list and provider-backed remainder accounting; never renormalize the top entries. Untimed/unanchored marks lack complete posterior payload and must state that limitation or use a checked producer extension. Acceptance: NN03 unit5 zero-fill does not lead ranked table; exact full accounting where supplied; synthetic ties/coarse/external-only/untimed cases. Integrate with bd-01M35A7B6R63M4B10R3J3XBW54.

Reuse the existing Voyage document/compiler/lowering/view; no new frontend or view-side scientific inference. Preserve semantic identities, supplied values, origin shapes, external-dominant hollows, group-level support and existing inspector exact text. Do not add native media boundaries or evidence links without checked producer capabilities. Record exact revision/artifact tuple and run affected Scala gates plus real-browser and synthetic failure witnesses. Existing frozen Sherlock artifacts are regression inputs, not scientific validation. Rollback: disable the new display/control and retain the existing checked Voyage route; never rewrite original artifacts. An actual Intaglio deficiency belongs in ~/code/scala/intaglio with its own Mote ticket and producer-consumer witness. No renderer defect is established by this ticket.
set.title: [Voyage] Separate the drawn decision from the ranked posterior
